title: Micronutrient requirements of wheat in Canterbury, New Zealand
authors: Curtin D, Hanson R, van der Weerden TJ
journal: New Zealand Journal of Crop and Horticultural Science
notes: Year 2 trials at 3 sites measured grain Zn concentration (Table 8). The Zn treatment was Cu+Mn+Zn combined application vs control. Individual Zn-only treatment was not tested. The Cu+Mn+Zn treatment includes confounding micronutrients, but Zn is the primary driver of grain Zn changes. Text states Zn application significantly increased grain Zn (P<0.005) with average increase of 13.5%.
